name: Apostag (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow light blue border set in from the edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Apostag (a yellow cartouche with a church and a red-roofed building) above the words APOSTAG KÖZSÉG in green.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
